lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Highroller,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: are you with Blanc and Noir

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: by any chance right now?
No, why?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Where could those two have gone?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: The next performance is about to begin,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but I don't see them in the waiting room,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: and I can't get a hold of them.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: They're nowhere to be found in Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Since they're always wandering off looking for you,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I was certain they'd be with you.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: If they're not with you,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: this may be a serious problem.
Could they have gone out to have fun somewhere?
How about looking for them one more time?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: they would never.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: After all, they place their performances

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: above all else.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: They would never act so irresponsibly.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: That may be a good idea.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I've been looking for them on my own,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but now that there isn't much time left,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I should probably have the staff help me.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: just one moment.
Sure?
For a while, there is no response from Rouge.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I found them.
Where were they?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: They misread the time.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: They thought the performance was an hour from now,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: so they went out to

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: get some supplies they needed for the performance.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Fortunately, they returned just before the starting time,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: so I hurried them on stage a moment ago.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Whew,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: that was close.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I need to pay more attention to this kind of stuff.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I apologize for causing you unnecessary worry.
Not at all. Feel free to contact me anytime.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Thank you, Highroller.
